rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 29 August 1990, in the short duration discussion on the situation in Sri Lanka, Shrimati Jayanthi Natarajan says that the unity and integrity of Sri Lanka underlay the Indo-Sri Lankan Accord 'that the former Prime Minister and the Congress President, Shri Rajiv Gandhi, had entered into'.
